statement.zh: 哈布巴卡比拉的第四千纪规划城镇及南部/乌鲁克相关物质文化见 Strommenger 1980（DOG 发掘）。
statement.en: At Habuba Kabira, a fourth-millennium planned town with southern/Uruk-related material culture is documented in Strommenger 1980 (DOG excavations).

editorial.notes: Fact about excavated town as presented by Strommenger; not an endorsement of expansion models. | Substance tighten 2026-10-12: Tightened: planned town assemblage first.
